title: Why Surah Al-Asr shook Imam Shafi'i
translation: Imam Shafi'i said if people reflected on Surah Al-Asr alone, it would suffice them. Because it contains entire manhaj of success.
lesson: My personal take: We often focus on knowledge ('haq') but neglect phase 4: advising patience. Truth without patience breaks community. Patience without truth loses direction. Both needed.
reflection: I read this surah 3x after Fajr for a week. Each day I ask: Did I do amal salih? Did I advise truth? Did I advise patience? It changes how I view busyness.
